name: ride-long
description: T-213: a ride longer than the frozen-troll watchdog (30 s) is not interrupted: the troll stands under the rider for 40 s with the AI off, nobody rebuilds it, the player is still on the seat.

asserts.name: stt.rideRidden
asserts.label: still riding after 40 s standing still (not rebuilt, not thrown off)

asserts.name: stt.rideSeatDelta
asserts.label: the player still sits on the seat (cm)

asserts.name: stt.rideStill
asserts.label: T-217 R2: after 40 s without input the troll stands where it settled (not Drifting)

asserts.name: stt.rideDrift
asserts.label: T-217 R2: root drift of the standing ridden troll in 40 s (cm)

asserts.name: stt.rideAnchorGap
asserts.label: USER 2026-11-10 10:37 ("the player's ass is not glued to the chair ... the chair follows the troll but the player goes too much forward and slides into the troll"): the rider's seat point is ON the seat bone in every frame, also while the troll only sways (cm; measured 23.5 / 43.4 cm in run a26-full1 with the idle easing of D-202..D-208 = FAILS until the rider is glued to the chair, PLAN T-217 R10)

asserts.name: stt.rideTiltGap
asserts.label: USER 2026-11-10 10:37: the rider leans exactly as the chair does in every frame (degrees; the rider kept a fixed rotation while the chair swayed = FAILS until R10 is done)
